name: Saksham Subramanian
subtitle: Data Analytics Batch - 2024
review: Workskills is a good learning platform for freshers or students looking to start a career in data analytics. The course content is up-to-date and the mentors are great. The live sessions are amazing of everything is taught from basic to intermediate to advance in a good pace. The live projects are very helpful. The structured teaching approach is spot-on for data essentials, and they fulfill their promise for certificates and refunds, making them a reliable choice. They teach everything very structurally and very accurate requirement in the data field. And at the end after completion they provide certificates, and most importantly they do what they say about refund. I enrolled in their data analytics course and was impressed by the knowledge shared by the trainers and their practical approach for teaching data analysis, the course content was up to date, and their dashboard was user-friendly. My experience with Workskills was great! It helped me a lot in gaining knowledge towards data analytics. I highly recommend Workskills for career growth.
